title: Automation-Assisted Work Cells
html:
Automation-Assisted Work Cells

Accudyne Systems’ Automation-Assisted Work Cell portfolio incorporates five elemental automation technologies: Automatic Tool Positioning; Laser Projection; Ply Backing Accountability; Integrated Work-Order and Recipe Management; and Manufacturing Information System Integration.

The integration of these elements into completely custom designs for each client’s equipment solution is Accudyne Systems’ strength.  Component type, size, and material system can vary greatly, so Automation-Assisted Work Cell configurations are tailored to meet the unique needs of the manufacturing process.  The business case for capital equipment investment has to be profitable for our clients, so Accudyne assists with Return-On-Investment studies.

Please read more about Automation-Assisted Work Cells in our publications library.
